title: Coconut Farm
introduction: ‘Coconut Farm’ is developed as a mathematical investigation rather than a list of rules. The chapter connects equal groups, multiplication, division, arrays, repeated addition. Learners are expected to represent quantities or relationships, choose a strategy, calculate carefully, check the result and explain the reasoning.
